projects.name: BestRide (startup) / Final Year Project
projects.description: Final-year project addressing operational challenges in Lisbon's Tuk Tuk sector through separate mobile applications for tourists and drivers or companies. I developed the frontend with Angular and Ionic and used AWS to host both applications and automate deployments. Grade: 15 (1-20).
